name: zclass_world_delete_node
description: zClass_World::DeleteNode frees world-owned area/light/sound/update arrays and then returns the node through TryFreeNode.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers owned world-list cleanup and node free-list return. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass world/deletion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450240 validates FreeVirtualAreaPartitions, conditional frees of lightNodes, lightDataList, soundNodes, soundDataList, and pendingAreaUpdates, then TryFreeNode.
The native smoke verifies allocated world-owned arrays are accepted by the production delete path and that the node returns to the global free list.
